limitations: This run reopens generated XCF/PNG inputs and paints/saves the PNG; the separate first application report qualifies creating/saving both formats.
Preference backup rename remains unsupported; shared-memory tile transport uses its fallback.
The shell-launched GIMP was a zero-CPU zombie after Quit until its winterm parent collected status 0 with wait; it and Script-Fu were then absent.
The PNG Load input sequence produced two windows with the edited content; the input-repetition cause was not isolated.
Full plug-in coverage, large images, tile swapping, recovery, printing and extended sessions remain unqualified.
